issue_context.title: Using quick-retry hotkey in results screen when stats are expanded results in black screen
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug:** 
Using the quick-retry hotkey in the results screen when the play statistics are expanded results in a black screen, which go backs to the player loader when exited (as seen in the attached video).

Reproduction steps:
1. Play a beatmap and reach the results screen
2. Expand the statistics
3. Press your quick-retry hotkey


**Screenshots or videos showing encountered issue:** 
https://streamable.com/mit0rq
**osu!lazer version:** 
Happens on latest `master`

**Logs:**
Irrelevant here.
comments:
Seems like that conditional is the culprit:
https://github.com/ppy/osu/blob/7e48df3a0dc3f69bc61c875b6ab0c1dee67f464a/osu.Game/Screens/Ranking/ResultsScreen.cs#L198-L202

This blocks retrying (using the hotkey as well as the retry button) when play statistics are expanded, not sure that behaviour is intended.

review_comments: I'm not sure I'm following why both `AllowBackButton` and `OnBackButton` need to exist. `OnBackButton` seems like the more general mechanism and can probably supersede all usages of `AllowBackButton`, unless I'm missing something.

`AllowBackButton` is there to hide the back button and disable its action on certain screens (like player doesn't need a back button, and has local exit logic).

`OnBackButton` is there to override the action, and only logical to implement if `AllowBackButton` is true.
